conbody.p: To help you park safely, the Extended Rear View Monitor function maintains the Rear View display when you shift the gear from R (Reverse) into N (Neutral) or D (Drive).

section.title: Operating conditions
section.p: Extended Rear View Monitor operates when you shift the gear from R (Reverse) into N (Neutral) or D (Drive) and your vehicle speed is below 10 km/h (6 mph).

section.title: Non-operating conditions
section.p: Extended Rear View Monitor turns OFF under the following conditions:

li.p: You shift the gear to P (Park).
You press the back button (3) on the Rear View Monitor screen.
You press the infotainment system operation button (4).
Vehicle speed is above 10 km/h (6 mph).
